articles.title: Yokogawa Electric (TSE:6841) Stock Looks Fairly Valued On Cash Flow
articles.summary: Yokogawa Electric has given long term holders a strong payoff over the past few years, yet the recent pullback raises a simple question for anyone looking at the ticker today. Is the current share price adequately backed by the cash flows that the business can realistically generate over time, or has sentiment moved faster than the underlying money coming in the door?
